podcast.title: Early Career on Sun Records
podcast.body: Johnny Cash and the Tennessee Two were a "two-guitar and base rockabilly act" that recorded for Sun Records. "A couple of months before Mystery Train he put out another single by a two-gitar and base rockabilly act. Hey Porter by Johnny Cash and the Tennessee two."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Initial Lack of Stardom
podcast.body: At the time of their early releases on Sun Records, Johnny Cash "didn't seem to be star material." "But right now he didn't seem to be star material."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
